data.title: 椎名真由理 · 万宝屋前的夏日冰棒
data.description: 秋叶原街角的自动贩卖机旁，真由理掰开双棒冰，将多的一半递了过来。蝉鸣声中，她嘴里咬着冰棒，发梢随着蹦跳的脚步一晃一晃。
data.location: sun-baked Tokyo side street next to a colorful drink vending machine
data.action: standing on asphalt road snapping a double popsicle into two pieces, offering the larger half with a cheerful playful wink
data.lighting: intense midsummer daylight casting sharp shadows and brilliant highlights on yellow t-shirt
data.mood: carefree childhood nostalgia, refreshing summer sweetness, cheerful everyday happiness
data.promptProse: Standing in bright summer sunshine by a vending machine, Mayuri happily shares a split popsicle, smiling radiantly in her yellow tee.
data.animaCaption: Mayuri offering half of a double popsicle on a sunny city corner with a sunny smile.
